description:
About the Scholarship

TFMASA trains engineers in heat and mass transfer, fluid mechanics and advanced materials for sustainable aeronautics, with the consortium coordinated from the University of Bordeaux. The scholarship round for the 2027 intake closes on 1 December 2026 at 10:00 CET, which makes this one of the earliest Erasmus Mundus deadlines of the season.

HostTFMASA Consortium (Université de Bordeaux)
LocationBordeaux (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded

Application Deadline1 December 2026
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

TFMASA trains engineers in heat and mass transfer, fluid mechanics and advanced materials for sustainable aeronautics, with the consortium coordinated from the University of Bordeaux. The scholarship round for the 2027 intake closes on 1 December 2026 at 10:00 CET, which makes this one of the earliest Erasmus Mundus deadlines of the season.

Programme Highlights

  • Aeronautics-focused curriculum with industry links to the Bordeaux aerospace cluster
  • Mobility across European partner universities with an integrated internship or thesis period
  • Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline lands on 1 December 2026 — apply early
  • Graduates enter aerospace R&D, propulsion, and thermal-management engineering roles

Who Should Apply

Mechanical, aerospace, energy or materials engineering graduates with strong fluid dynamics and thermodynamics backgrounds fit the programme best. English test evidence follows the standard Erasmus Mundus requirements.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs covered plus a monthly allowance and travel support.

Deadline and How to Apply

Prepare documents in October and submit through the TFMASA application page well before the 1 December 2026, 10:00 CET cut-off. Key deadline information: 1 December 2026 (10:00 CET) — scholarship round.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About TFMASA Consortium (Université De Bordeaux)

The TFMASA consortium, coordinated by the University of Bordeaux, delivers the Erasmus Mundus International Master in Transfers, Fluids and Materials for Aeronautics and Sustainable Applications with aerospace-focused European partners.

Official website: https://tfmasa.com

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
